lines.zh: 脚步沉重，如同千年牢笼的叹息。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps, like a千年牢笼的叹息千年 prison’s sigh.

lines.zh: 铁链摩擦，发出刺耳的声音。
lines.en: Chains scrape, making an ear-piercing sound.

lines.zh: 摸索着前行，每一步都艰难。
lines.en: Treading with difficulty, each step is tough.
Chains jingle with each step.
Empty gaze, staring straight ahead.

lines.zh: 双手紧握铁链，仿佛要挣脱。
lines.en: Hands tightly grasp the chains, as if trying to break free.

lines.zh: 步伐缓慢而坚定，如幽灵般飘过。
lines.en: Slow and resolute steps, passing like a ghost.

lines.zh: 铁环撞击地面，发出低沉的声音。
lines.en: Metal clinks on the ground, a low sound.

lines.zh: 步履蹒跚，像是被无形的枷锁束缚。
lines.en: Staggering steps, as if bound by invisible chains.

lines.zh: 每走一步，都像是在回忆深渊。
lines.en: Each step is a recollection of the abyss.

lines.zh: 锁链拖在地上，我还在走。
lines.en: My chains drag on the ground, yet I walk.

lines.zh: 脚镣磨破了皮，路没有尽头。
lines.en: The shackles rub my skin raw. The road never ends.

lines.zh: 双眼空洞，仿佛看到了无尽黑暗。
lines.en: Empty eyes, seeing endless darkness.

lines.zh: 呆滞地站立，凝视着虚无。
lines.en: Stood呆滞地, staring at nothingness.

lines.zh: 双手紧握铁链，沉默无声。
lines.en: Hands tightly grip the chains, silent.

lines.zh: 目光游离，寻找着不存在的希望。
lines.en: Gaze游离, searching for nonexistent hope.

lines.zh: 双手插入口袋，似乎在自言自语。
lines.en: Hands in pockets, as if talking to oneself.
Occasionally murmurs lowly.
Empty eyes gaze into the distance.

lines.zh: 紧闭的双唇，似乎在念叨着什么。
lines.en: Closed lips, muttering something.

lines.zh: 静止不动，像是被时间遗忘。
lines.en: Still, as if forgotten by time.

lines.zh: 沉默中，内心深处的痛苦。
lines.en: Silent, the pain within.

lines.zh: 我数着深渊里的滴水声。
lines.en: I count the water dripping in the abyss.
The cell stands open, and I dare not leave.

lines.zh: 指甲在墙上又划了一道。
lines.en: Another mark scratched into the wall.

lines.zh: 这件囚衣已经烂成布条。
lines.en: This prison garb has rotted to strips.

lines.zh: 瞬间盯紧玩家，充满敌意。
lines.en: Instantly locks on the player, filled with hostility.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，寻找着攻击机会。
lines.en: Gaze flickers, seeking an attack.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛已经习惯黑暗。
lines.en: My eyes are used to darkness.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，随时准备攻击。
lines.en: Gaze flickers, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 死死盯着玩家，不放过一丝机会。
lines.en: Fixated on the player, not missing a chance.
Sharp gaze, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 目光如刀，锐利地盯着玩家。
lines.en: Gaze like a knife, sharply staring at the player.

lines.zh: 我在黑暗里数你的呼吸。
lines.en: I count your breaths in the dark.

lines.zh: 目光中透露出贪婪与恐惧。
lines.en: Gaze透露出贪婪与恐惧greedy and fearful.

lines.zh: 死死盯住玩家，不敢放松警惕。
lines.en: Staring intently at the player, not letting down guard.
Your key... is it for me?
Were you thrown down here too?
Don't go. I know the way out.
You wear no chains. That must be nice.
I watch the door. I watch you too.
Could you break this cage open?

lines.zh: 你的脚步让我想起看守。
lines.en: Your footsteps remind me of the gaoler.

lines.zh: 我在数你还差几步走近。
lines.en: I'm counting the steps until you reach me.
Don't pity me. Take me out.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，借我看看。
lines.en: Let me see that torch of yours.
The prisoner moans weakly.
The prisoner groans in pain.
The prisoner pants in agony.
The prisoner howls in agony.
The prisoner howls, trembling.
The prisoner struggles to howl.
The prisoner roars in agony.
The prisoner screams in agony.
The prisoner howls.
The prisoner screams.

lines.zh: 你靠近得越近，我的牢狱就越大。
lines.en: The closer you get, the bigger my prison grows.

lines.zh: 深渊中的腐烂，滋养着我的饥渴。
lines.en: Rot in the depths feeds my hunger.
Your escape is mine?
Prison rations were never enough.
Your despair is my cage.
Your weakness, my hope.

lines.zh: 深渊里的食物，从来不新鲜。
lines.en: Food in the abyss is never fresh.
Hunger is an eternal curse.
My presence, your nightmare.
I've waited too long for you to come.

lines.zh: 碰触我，你就触及了深渊。
lines.en: Touch me, and you touch the depths.
Your collision awakens me.

lines.zh: 坚硬的外壳，无用的抵抗。
lines.en: Hard shells, futile resistance.
These shackles aren't off yet.

lines.zh: 我的触碰，是无尽的痛苦。
lines.en: My touch, endless pain.

lines.zh: 你撞得越用力，我越强大。
lines.en: The harder you hit, the stronger I become.

lines.zh: 铁链在我脖子上磨出茧。
lines.en: The chain has worn calluses on my neck.

lines.zh: 每一次碰撞，都是我的养分。
lines.en: Every collision feeds me.

lines.zh: 你的冲撞，激起我的怒火。
lines.en: Your collision stirs my rage.

lines.zh: 我的存在，粉碎你的世界。
lines.en: My presence, shatters your world.
Find a mate, find freedom.

lines.zh: 同类的呼唤，是解脱之路。
lines.en: The call of a mate is the path to freedom.
Why don't you come closer?

lines.zh: 同类之间，才能真正理解。
lines.en: Only with a mate can you truly understand.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，是唯一的希望。
lines.en: My mate is my only hope.

lines.zh: 同类的存在，才是真的存在。
lines.en: The existence of a mate is true existence.

lines.zh: 靠近我，感受到我的存在。
lines.en: Come closer, feel my presence.
Your mate is nearby.
Find a mate, break free.

lines.zh: 同类的温暖，是你唯一的救赎。
lines.en: The warmth of a mate is your only salvation.
Metal links clink together.
Decaying teeth crunch.
Low hiss sounds up.
Grunts from the throat.
Sibilant in the throat.
Chain scrapes the ground.
Distorted face appears.
Sibilant with whispers.
The cell door rusted shut on me.
Iron chains rattle.
Eyes from the pit floor fix on you.
Growls low.
Hissing with menace.
Feral glint in eyes.
Approach with steps.
Sibilant draws near.

lines.zh: 井底的风，把你的味带下来。
lines.en: The shaft's draft brings your scent down.
Eyes like blades.
Growls with anger.
Sibilant with roars.
You stand between me and the exit.

lines.zh: 我要的是钥匙，不是你的命。
lines.en: I want your key, not your life.

lines.zh: 这副镣铐该换个人戴了。
lines.en: Someone else should wear these shackles.
Catch you, and I'll have company.
Down here, the living are supplies.
You struck first. Don't blame me.
Bites target.
Holds prey tight.
Rips flesh.
I crawl down the shaft wall.
Grunts contentedly.
Tear apart flesh.
Target's pained hiss.
Bites with teeth.
Grunts greedily.
Tears meat apart.
Toss the key over.
Once I grab you, I don't let go.

lines.zh: 你的喉咙离我的牙很近。
lines.en: Your throat is close to my teeth.
The chain wraps around your wrist.
I'll drag you down with me.
Don't run. I know this path.
You'll stay in the cage instead of me.
Ten years of wear loosened my chains.
Your blood will grease this lock.
The prison taught me this punch.
Sss, try moving!
I'll tear your skin!
I sharpened my teeth on the stone.

lines.zh: 逃不掉的，我的力量比你大！
lines.en: You can't escape, my strength is greater!

lines.zh: 你的骨骼会在我口中断裂！
lines.en: Your bones will snap in my mouth!
Don't try to resist!
You're one step from death!

lines.zh: 我的利爪能让你血流不止！
lines.en: My claws will make you bleed!
Shiver, you're dying!

lines.zh: 我从背后拧住你的手腕。
lines.en: I twist your wrist from behind.
The chain lashes your face!
Taste a prisoner's fist!
I'll strip that coat off you!
This one is for the gaoler!
Got you. Don't bother struggling!
Your bones will pick this lock!
The Abyss calls me again!
A new prisoner!

lines.zh: 我能感觉到他们的恐惧！
lines.en: I can feel their fear!
They will join my ranks!

lines.zh: 等待着我的是更多的囚犯！
lines.en: More prisoners await!

lines.zh: 我的同类很快就会到来！
lines.en: My kind will come soon!
They don't know my strength!
They are my prey!
A new sacrifice, soon to be born!
I'll devour their fear!
The abyss spat me back into the cell.
The iron door clanged, and I woke.

lines.zh: 又是这座监狱，又是这身锁。
lines.en: This prison again. These chains again.
They threw me down. I didn't die.

lines.zh: 名字被划掉的人回来了。
lines.en: The one whose name was struck out is back.
The chain is still here. So am I.
There is one more prisoner in the dark.
I opened my eyes at the bottom of the pit.
Who did the gaoler shove in this time?
A living man crawls out of the stone crack.
The prisoner is burned by flames.
The prisoner falls and injures itself.
The prisoner drowns.
The prisoner is injured by the explosion.
The prisoner is hit by a projectile.
The prisoner is injured by magic.
The prisoner starves to death.
The prisoner is struck by lightning.
The prisoner falls into the void.
